sections.title: Intellectual property
sections.body: The FleetAi brand, logo, interface, texts, illustrations and source code are protected by intellectual property law and remain the exclusive property of the publisher. Your subscription grants you a personal, non-exclusive right to use the service, with no transfer of ownership. Any reproduction, extraction or reuse, in whole or in part, without prior written permission is prohibited. The data you upload to FleetAi remains yours and is not covered by this clause.

sections.title: Personal data and cookies
sections.body: How personal data is processed (purposes, legal basis, retention periods, processors, how to exercise your rights) is described in detail in our privacy policy. For any request about your data, write to the address below.

sections.title: Reporting illegal content
sections.body: Under article 6-I-5 of the LCEN, any manifestly illegal content hosted on the service can be reported to us by email at support@fleetai.app. The report should state the date, a description of the content, where it is located and the reasons why it should be removed.
